blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines —Marygrace Melendres has already experienced the thrill of winning a championship and earning Most Valuable Player honors in high school volleyball. Now, the promising spiker is ready to prove herself on a bigger stage. As the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 women’s collegiate volleyball tournament approaches, Melendres is preparing for her rookie campaign with the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Lady Jaguars, carrying both the confidence earned from her high school success and the determination to help her new team reclaim the championship.
